articles.title: India-France adopt Innovation Roadmap 2030, unveil 13 outcomes during PM Modi’s visit
articles.summary: India and France unveiled 13 significant outcomes during Prime Minister Modi's visit, strengthening bilateral ties across crucial sectors. These agreements span innovation, Artificial Intelligence, trade, education, space, and strategic cooperation. This deepening partnership is vital for India's technological advancement, economic growth, and global standing, reinforcing strategic autonomy and national interests.

articles.title: How one Australian woman survived the sinking of the Titanic and why no one knows about her
articles.summary: The RMS Titanic, celebrated as the largest, most magnificent, and expensive ship ever built, was famously considered unsinkable. Tragically, on its maiden transatlantic voyage across the Atlantic, it struck an iceberg. This well-known disaster highlighted the limitations of engineering despite its grandeur and initial claims of invincibility.

articles.title: It’s a Most Confusing Time To Be in the US Military
articles.summary: This excerpt describes a period of significant confusion within the U.S. military, where personnel reportedly question the reasons for their engagements. The author points to a perceived absence of clear principles and strategic clarity from the leadership. This assessment highlights a potential disconnect and uncertainty at the top levels, creating a challenging environment for service members regarding their purpose and direction.

articles.title: Dhiraj Bommadevara completes golden double with maiden individual World Cup gold
articles.summary: Archer Dhiraj Bommadevara secured a memorable golden double in Antalya, clinching his maiden individual title. He achieved this by stunning Paris Olympics bronze medallist Lee Woo Seok of South Korea 7-3 in a gripping final. This impressive victory showcases India's growing strength in archery and reflects a high level of skill and composure under pressure, bringing national pride on the international stage.

articles.title: UK forces intercept Russian 'shadow fleet' tanker in the English Channel
articles.summary: British armed forces have intercepted a sanctioned Russian oil tanker in the English Channel. This operation marks the first direct action to disrupt Russia's oil revenue, a critical source for funding its ongoing war in Ukraine. The move underscores international efforts to enforce sanctions and pressure Moscow economically, highlighting the maritime dimension of the conflict and the role of naval power in enforcing global policies.

articles.title: A final video call, a last photo: Bihar families mourn IAF personnel killed in Assam crash
articles.summary: Families in Patna are preserving the last digital memories of their Indian Air Force sons. A mother recalls a video call, another treasures a photo sent from an aircraft, underscoring the poignant sacrifices made by defence personnel and their loved ones. This highlights the enduring emotional impact on families of those serving in the IAF.
